verdict.rationale: Kling documents image-to-video as a core capability (kling-docs-37), with priced Image to Video modes that include start/end frame control (kling-docs-20, kling-docs-21). It also explicitly markets turning still images into cinematic motion (kling-docs-31). Subject preservation is only implied, through start/end frame anchoring and the Elements system for persistent character identity (kling-docs-13). missing for 10: explicit documentation that subject and composition fidelity is preserved from the source image, independent or hands-on corroboration of image-to-video fidelity.
